experiment_evidence: The synthetic-prediction smoothness experiment sets n=500, n_instances=128 and benchmark=uniform_benchmark; loads data/tsp_uniform_benchmark/500_0000.pkl at s=0; and perturbs edges of its stored optimal tour.
optimal_tour_source: Dataset node opt_tour ranks, checked against edge opt_tour and in_solution flags. Authors report Concorde optimal tours; no solver was run locally to independently prove optimality.
tour_indexing: 500_0000.opt.tour uses TSPLIB 1-based IDs and implicit closure. JSON and pickle use 0-based IDs.
weight_convention: Original weight attributes match unrounded Euclidean distances; maximum absolute difference over all edges recorded below. Coordinate JSON preserves these weights via Euclidean distance; TSPLIB EUC_2D integer rounding would change the instance.

files.500_0000.pkl: Original downloaded NetworkX graph, with coordinates, edge weights, predictions and optimal tour.
files.500_0000.json: Readable equivalent coordinate instance, usable without NetworkX or NumPy.
files.500_0000.opt.tour: Optimal cycle extracted from the downloaded graph, in TSPLIB TOUR format.
